label: Agglomeration
definition: Code of the agglomeration concerned, as accepted in the {ref}`spatial-points` dataflow.

label: Area concerned
definition: Description of the area within the agglomeration where the deadline cannot be met.

label: Deadline concerned
definition: The deadline or deadlines that cannot be met in the area. Select one or both.

label: Adjusted deadline
definition: The year by the end of which the required infrastructure will be finalised in the area.
